label: WUSD depeg low ~$0.97, liquidity stress
note: 2024-09-15: WUSD depeg low ~$0.97; liquidity stress event.

label: CEX delisting cascade: MEXC, Bitget and Coins.ph exit WUSD
note: 2026-07-25: MEXC ST-tagged WUSD on 07-22 and delisted it 07-25; Bitget removed WUSD/USDT on 07-31; Coins.ph, the flagship WUSD/PHP retail venue, delisted 08-04 citing WUSD no longer meeting its listing standards. Pinned at the first delisting; the Coins.ph notice is the only one of the three that states a reason.

label: 94% of supply redeemed: WUSD circulating falls 9.99M to 0.61M
note: 2026-07-29: largest single-day burn of the contraction: 8.39M to 2.21M, followed by 2.21M to 0.61M on 08-01. Circulating fell 9.99M (07-21) to 0.61M, ~94%, with primary redemption KYB-gated to qualified businesses. No issuer statement accompanied it.
